messages:
Ivy R.: dropping a compact mock for an 'Invoke Explorer' that combines run history + small inline schema editor. Aim: keyboard-first, quick diffs, low visual noise. feedback?
Ben C.: Nice. For long JSON args show a single-line summary with 'Show details' button.
Sam K.: Agree. 'Show details' should have aria-expanded and include run id in label.
Ana P.: Microcopy: use 'Edit tool definition' instead of 'Edit function'. Keep wording consistent with Console.
Ben C.: Keyboard map proposal: Up/Down to move, Right to open, Left to collapse, Enter to edit. Scope only when focus is in the run region.
Ivy R.: Accessibility: diff pills need focusable controls and Escape closes popovers restoring focus. Announce open/close with aria-live.
Sam K.: Perf: virtualize the list and hydrate editor only on demand. Cache parsed schemas.
Ana P.: Action items: Ben - add aria labels to mock. Sam - virtualization notes. Ivy - update copy and attach a short recording. ux-bot: Created ticket INVOKE-3010 with checklist.
